name: Master_Position_id
xsql:
SELECT pos.master_position_id,
         MIN(pos.name) AS position_name
  FROM xactly.xc_participant master_part
  JOIN xactly.xc_period curr ON 1 = 1
  LEFT JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa
    ON ppa.participant_id = master_part.participant_id
  JOIN xactly.xc_position pos
    ON pos.position_id            = ppa.position_id
    AND pos.effective_start_date  < curr.end_date
    AND pos.effective_end_date    > curr.start_date
    AND pos.incent_st_date        < curr.end_date
    AND pos.incent_end_date       > curr.start_date
  WHERE master_part.participant_id = :v_master_participant_id
    AND master_part.is_master      = 1
    AND curr.name                  = :v_period
  GROUP BY pos.master_position_id

name: q_sd_annual_credits_by_measure
xsql:
SELECT
    q.name AS measure_name,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(cr.amount), '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS annual_ytd_credits,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(tg.annual_quota, '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS annual_quota,
    CASE WHEN Nvl(tg.annual_quota, 0) > 0
         THEN Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(cr.amount) / tg.annual_quota * 100, '#,##0.00'), '0.00') || '%'
         ELSE '—' END AS annual_attainment_pct
FROM xactly.xc_participant master_part
JOIN xactly.xc_period curr ON 1=1
JOIN xactly.xc_commission cm
    ON cm.participant_id = master_part.participant_id
    AND cm.position_id = :v_master_position_id
JOIN xactly.xc_credit cr ON cr.credit_id = cm.credit_id
JOIN xactly.xc_period per
    ON per.period_id = cm.period_id
    AND per.name LIKE Concat('%-', :v_year_number)
    AND per.end_date <= curr.end_date
JOIN xactly.xc_quota q ON q.quota_id = cm.quota_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT qa.quota_id, SUM(qa.amount) AS annual_quota
    FROM xactly.xc_quota_assignment qa
    JOIN xactly.xc_period yp ON yp.period_id = qa.period_id
    WHERE qa.assignment_id = :v_master_position_id
      AND yp.name LIKE Concat('%-', :v_year_number)
    GROUP BY qa.quota_id
) tg ON tg.quota_id = q.quota_id
WHERE master_part.participant_id = :v_master_participant_id
  AND master_part.is_master = 1
  AND curr.name = :v_period
GROUP BY q.name, tg.annual_quota
ORDER BY q.name

name: q_sd_payouts_by_measure

    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(CASE WHEN pay.is_released = '1' THEN pay.amount ELSE 0 END), '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS released_payout,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(CASE WHEN Nvl(pay.is_released,'0') != '1' THEN pay.amount ELSE 0 END), '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS pending_payout
FROM xactly.xc_participant master_part
JOIN xactly.xc_period curr ON 1=1
JOIN xactly.xc_commission cm
    ON cm.participant_id = master_part.participant_id
    AND cm.position_id = :v_master_position_id
JOIN xactly.xc_period per
    ON per.period_id = cm.period_id
    AND per.name LIKE Concat('%-', :v_year_number)
    AND per.end_date <= curr.end_date
JOIN xactly.xc_quota q ON q.quota_id = cm.quota_id
LEFT JOIN xactly.xc_payment pay
    ON pay.eff_participant_id = master_part.participant_id
    AND pay.period_id = cm.period_id
WHERE master_part.participant_id = :v_master_participant_id
  AND master_part.is_master = 1
  AND curr.name = :v_period

name: q_sd_qtr_credits_by_measure
xsql:
SELECT
    q.name AS measure_name,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(cr.amount), '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS qtr_ytd_credits,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(tg.tgt, '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS qtr_quota,
    CASE WHEN Nvl(tg.tgt, 0) > 0
         THEN Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(cr.amount) / tg.tgt * 100, '#,##0.00'), '0.00') || '%'
         ELSE '—' END AS attainment_pct
FROM xactly.xc_participant master_part
JOIN xactly.xc_period curr ON 1=1
JOIN xactly.xc_commission cm
    ON cm.participant_id = master_part.participant_id
    AND cm.position_id = :v_master_position_id
JOIN xactly.xc_credit cr ON cr.credit_id = cm.credit_id
JOIN xactly.xc_period per ON per.period_id = cm.period_id AND per.name = :v_period
JOIN xactly.xc_quota q ON q.quota_id = cm.quota_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT qa.quota_id, SUM(qa.amount) AS tgt
    FROM xactly.xc_quota_assignment qa
    JOIN xactly.xc_period yp ON yp.period_id = qa.period_id
    WHERE qa.assignment_id = :v_master_position_id
      AND yp.name = :v_period
    GROUP BY qa.quota_id
) tg ON tg.quota_id = q.quota_id
WHERE master_part.participant_id = :v_master_participant_id
  AND master_part.is_master = 1
  AND curr.name = :v_period

name: q_sd_quota_attainment_by_measure
xsql:
SELECT
    quota_name,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(Round(att, 2), '#,##0.00'), '0.00') || '%' AS attainment_pct,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(cred, '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS total_credit,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(tgt, '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS quota_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        q.name AS quota_name,
        Nvl(b.cred, 0) AS cred,
        tg.tgt AS tgt,
        CASE WHEN tg.tgt > 0 THEN Nvl(b.cred, 0) / tg.tgt * 100 ELSE 0 END AS att
    FROM (
        SELECT qa.quota_id, Max(qa.amount) AS tgt
        FROM xactly.xc_quota_assignment qa
        JOIN xactly.xc_period yp ON yp.period_id = qa.period_id
        WHERE qa.assignment_id = :v_master_position_id
          AND yp.name LIKE Concat('%-', :v_year_number)
        GROUP BY qa.quota_id
    ) tg
    JOIN xactly.xc_quota q ON q.quota_id = tg.quota_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT cq.quota_id, SUM(cr.amount) AS cred
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT cm.quota_id, cm.credit_id
            FROM xactly.xc_commission cm
            WHERE cm.position_id = :v_master_position_id
        ) cq
        JOIN xactly.xc_credit cr ON cr.credit_id = cq.credit_id
        JOIN (
            SELECT period_id FROM xactly.xc_period
            WHERE name LIKE Concat('%-', :v_year_number)
              AND end_date <= (SELECT end_date FROM xactly.xc_period WHERE name = :v_period)
        ) ps ON ps.period_id = cr.period_id
        GROUP BY cq.quota_id
    ) b ON b.quota_id = tg.quota_id
)

name: ntr_db_es_top_perf
xsql:
SELECT 
    -- Top 1 Performer
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 1 THEN name END), '') AS top_1_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 1 THEN division END), '') AS top_1_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 1 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS top_1_val,
    
    -- Top 2 Performer
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 2 THEN name END), '') AS top_2_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 2 THEN division END), '') AS top_2_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 2 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS top_2_val,
    
    -- Top 3 Performer
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 3 THEN name END), '') AS top_3_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 3 THEN division END), '') AS top_3_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 3 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS top_3_val,
    
    -- Top 4 Performer
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 4 THEN name END), '') AS top_4_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 4 THEN division END), '') AS top_4_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 4 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS top_4_val,
    
    -- Top 5 Performer
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 5 THEN name END), '') AS top_5_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 5 THEN division END), '') AS top_5_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_top = 5 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS top_5_val

FROM (
    SELECT 
        name,
        division,
        payout,
        Row_Number() OVER (ORDER BY payout DESC) AS rn_top
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            SubString(p.participant_name, 0, IndexOf(p.participant_name, '(')) AS name,
            m.category AS division, 
            SUM(p.amount) AS payout
        FROM xactly.xc_payment p
        
        -- Embedded Title Mapping
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                pta.title_name AS title_name
            FROM xactly.xc_period per 
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
            WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
        ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
        
        INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
            ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
            AND pta.title_name = m.title
            
        WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
          AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
        GROUP BY 
            p.participant_name, 
            m.category
    ) AggData
) RankedData;

    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then Total_Payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as mix_9_payout,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then Bar_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_9_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then Vol_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_9_vol_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then Pts_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_9_pts_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then Others_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_9_others_pct,

    -- ROW 10
    Max(Case When rn = 10 Then ASR_Name End) as mix_10_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then Total_Payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as mix_10_payout,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then Bar_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_10_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then Vol_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_10_vol_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then Pts_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_10_pts_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then Others_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_10_others_pct

From (
    Select 
        ASR_Name,
        Total_Payout,
        (Total_Payout * 100.0 / Case When Max_Total = 0 Then 1 Else Max_Total End) as Bar_Pct,
        (Vol_Payout * 100.0 / Case When Total_Payout = 0 Then 1 Else Total_Payout End) as Vol_Pct,
        (Pts_Payout * 100.0 / Case When Total_Payout = 0 Then 1 Else Total_Payout End) as Pts_Pct,
        (Others_Payout * 100.0 / Case When Total_Payout = 0 Then 1 Else Total_Payout End) as Others_Pct,
        rn
    From (
        Select 
            ASR_Name,
            Total_Payout,
            Vol_Payout,
            Pts_Payout,
            Others_Payout,
            Max(Total_Payout) Over () as Max_Total,
            ROW_NUMBER() Over (Order By Total_Payout DESC) as rn
        From (
            Select 
                ASR_Name,
                Sum(amount) As Total_Payout,
                Sum(Case When sub_category = 'Volume Retention' Then amount Else 0 End) As Vol_Payout,
                Sum(Case When sub_category = 'Points Goal' Then amount Else 0 End) As Pts_Payout,
                Sum(Case When sub_category = 'Others' Then amount Else 0 End) As Others_Payout
            From (
                Select 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN IndexOf(pa_active.participant_name, '(') > 0 THEN SubString(pa_active.participant_name, 0, IndexOf(pa_active.participant_name, '(')) 
                        ELSE pa_active.participant_name 
                    END As ASR_Name,
                    p.amount,
                    Case 
                        When m.sub_category IS NULL Then tm.sub_category
                        Else m.sub_category
                    End As sub_category
                From xactly.xc_payment p
                
                /* Inlined Title Mapping */
                Inner Join (
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                        pta.title_name AS title
                    FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                        ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                        ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                        AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                        AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                        ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
                    WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
                ) title On p.participant_id = title.master_participant_id
                
                /* Inlined Territory Mapping & Region Filtering */
                Inner Join (
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                        pa_active.territory AS territory,
                        pa_active.region AS region,
                        pa_active.name AS participant_name
                    FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
                        ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
                        ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
                        AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                        AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                    WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
                ) pa_active On p.participant_id = pa_active.master_participant_id
                
                Inner Join NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
                    On p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
                    And title.title = m.title
                    And m.category = 'WH'
                Left Join NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
                    On pa_active.territory = tm.territory 
                    
                Where p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                  And p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
                  
                  -- Region Dashboard Filter
                  And ('ALL' IN (:p_region) OR pa_active.region IN (:p_region))
                  
                  And p.earning_group_name IN (
                      Select earning_group 
                      From NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING 
                      Where category = 'WH'
                  )

            ) raw_data
            Group By ASR_Name
        ) agg_data
    ) windowed_data
) final_data;

FROM xactly.xc_payment p

INNER JOIN (

        ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
        pta.title_name AS title_name
    FROM xactly.xc_period per 
    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa

    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
        ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
        AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
        AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
        ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
    WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id

-- 2. Inline Region Mapping Subquery (Pulled directly from xc_participant)
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
        pa_active.region AS region
    FROM xactly.xc_period per 
    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
        ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
        ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
        AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
        AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
    WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
) part_info ON p.participant_id = part_info.master_participant_id

INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m

SELECT 
    Coalesce(Oh_avg_val, 0) AS Oh_avg_val,
    Coalesce(Oh_p1_val, 0) AS Oh_p1_val,
    Coalesce(Oh_p2_val, 0) AS Oh_p2_val,
    Coalesce(Oh_others_val, 0) AS Oh_p3_val,
    
    Coalesce(Onc_avg_val, 0) AS Onc_avg_val,
    Coalesce(Onc_p1_val, 0) AS Onc_p1_val,
    Coalesce(Onc_p2_val, 0) AS Onc_p2_val,
    Coalesce(Onc_others_val, 0) AS Onc_p3_val,
    
    Coalesce(Wh_avg_val, 0) AS Wh_avg_val,
    Coalesce(Wh_p1_val, 0) AS Wh_p1_val,
    Coalesce(Wh_p2_val, 0) AS Wh_p2_val,
    Coalesce(Wh_others_val, 0) AS Wh_p3_val,
    
    -- Height calculation (column average relative to the tallest average column)
    Coalesce(Round((Oh_avg_val * 100.0) / CASE WHEN max_avg = 0 THEN 1 ELSE max_avg END, 0), 0) AS Oh_h_pct,
    Coalesce(Round((Onc_avg_val * 100.0) / CASE WHEN max_avg = 0 THEN 1 ELSE max_avg END, 0), 0) AS Onc_h_pct,
    Coalesce(Round((Wh_avg_val * 100.0) / CASE WHEN max_avg = 0 THEN 1 ELSE max_avg END, 0), 0) AS Wh_h_pct,
    
    -- Sub-category mix percentages (P1, P2, and Others inside the column)
    Coalesce(Round((Oh_p1_val * 100.0) / CASE WHEN Oh_avg_val = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Oh_avg_val END, 0), 0) AS Oh_s1_pct,
    Coalesce(Round((Oh_p2_val * 100.0) / CASE WHEN Oh_avg_val = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Oh_avg_val END, 0), 0) AS Oh_s2_pct,
    Coalesce(Round((Oh_others_val * 100.0) / CASE WHEN Oh_avg_val = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Oh_avg_val END, 0), 0) AS Oh_s3_pct,

    Coalesce(Round((Onc_p1_val * 100.0) / CASE WHEN Onc_avg_val = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Onc_avg_val END, 0), 0) AS Onc_s1_pct,
    Coalesce(Round((Onc_p2_val * 100.0) / CASE WHEN Onc_avg_val = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Onc_avg_val END, 0), 0) AS Onc_s2_pct,
    Coalesce(Round((Onc_others_val * 100.0) / CASE WHEN Onc_avg_val = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Onc_avg_val END, 0), 0) AS Onc_s3_pct,

    Coalesce(Round((Wh_p1_val * 100.0) / CASE WHEN Wh_avg_val = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Wh_avg_val END, 0), 0) AS Wh_s1_pct,
    Coalesce(Round((Wh_p2_val * 100.0) / CASE WHEN Wh_avg_val = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Wh_avg_val END, 0), 0) AS Wh_s2_pct,
    Coalesce(Round((Wh_others_val * 100.0) / CASE WHEN Wh_avg_val = 0 THEN 1 ELSE Wh_avg_val END, 0), 0) AS Wh_s3_pct

FROM (
    SELECT
        Oh_avg_val, Oh_p1_val, Oh_p2_val, Oh_others_val,
        Onc_avg_val, Onc_p1_val, Onc_p2_val, Onc_others_val,
        Wh_avg_val, Wh_p1_val, Wh_p2_val, Wh_others_val,
        
        CASE 
            WHEN Oh_avg_val >= Onc_avg_val AND Oh_avg_val >= Wh_avg_val THEN Oh_avg_val
            WHEN Onc_avg_val >= Wh_avg_val THEN Onc_avg_val
            ELSE Wh_avg_val 
        END AS max_avg
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            -- Calculate Averages (Total Division Amount / Number of Distinct Reps)
            Round(oh_tot / CASE WHEN oh_reps = 0 THEN 1 ELSE oh_reps END, 0) AS Oh_avg_val,
            Round(oh_p1_tot / CASE WHEN oh_reps = 0 THEN 1 ELSE oh_reps END, 0) AS Oh_p1_val,
            Round(oh_p2_tot / CASE WHEN oh_reps = 0 THEN 1 ELSE oh_reps END, 0) AS Oh_p2_val,
            Round(oh_others_tot / CASE WHEN oh_reps = 0 THEN 1 ELSE oh_reps END, 0) AS Oh_others_val,

            Round(onc_tot / CASE WHEN onc_reps = 0 THEN 1 ELSE onc_reps END, 0) AS Onc_avg_val,
            Round(onc_p1_tot / CASE WHEN onc_reps = 0 THEN 1 ELSE onc_reps END, 0) AS Onc_p1_val,
            Round(onc_p2_tot / CASE WHEN onc_reps = 0 THEN 1 ELSE onc_reps END, 0) AS Onc_p2_val,
            Round(onc_others_tot / CASE WHEN onc_reps = 0 THEN 1 ELSE onc_reps END, 0) AS Onc_others_val,

            Round(wh_tot / CASE WHEN wh_reps = 0 THEN 1 ELSE wh_reps END, 0) AS Wh_avg_val,
            Round(wh_p1_tot / CASE WHEN wh_reps = 0 THEN 1 ELSE wh_reps END, 0) AS Wh_p1_val,
            Round(wh_p2_tot / CASE WHEN wh_reps = 0 THEN 1 ELSE wh_reps END, 0) AS Wh_p2_val,
            Round(wh_others_tot / CASE WHEN wh_reps = 0 THEN 1 ELSE wh_reps END, 0) AS Wh_others_val
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                -- Organ Health Totals & Rep Count
                SUM(CASE WHEN m.category = 'OH' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS oh_tot,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.category = 'OH' AND p.amount != 0 THEN p.participant_id END) AS oh_reps,
                SUM(CASE WHEN m.category = 'OH' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Prospera' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS oh_p1_tot,
                SUM(CASE WHEN m.category = 'OH' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Renasight' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS oh_p2_tot,
                SUM(CASE WHEN m.category = 'OH' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Others' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS oh_others_tot,

                -- Oncology Totals & Rep Count
                SUM(CASE WHEN m.category = 'ONC' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS onc_tot,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.category = 'ONC' AND p.amount != 0 THEN p.participant_id END) AS onc_reps,
                SUM(CASE WHEN m.category = 'ONC' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Initial Patients' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS onc_p1_tot,
                SUM(CASE WHEN m.category = 'ONC' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Follow On Patients' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS onc_p2_tot,
                SUM(CASE WHEN m.category = 'ONC' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Others' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS onc_others_tot,

                -- Women's Health Totals & Rep Count
                SUM(CASE WHEN m.category = 'WH' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS wh_tot,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.category = 'WH' AND p.amount != 0 THEN p.participant_id END) AS wh_reps,
                SUM(CASE WHEN m.category = 'WH' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Volume Retention' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS wh_p1_tot,
                SUM(CASE WHEN m.category = 'WH' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Points Goal' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS wh_p2_tot,
                SUM(CASE WHEN m.category = 'WH' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Others' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS wh_others_tot

            FROM xactly.xc_payment p
            
            -- Embedded Title Mapping
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                    pta.title_name AS title_name
                FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                    ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                    ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                    ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
                WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
            ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
            
            -- Embedded Territory Mapping (LEFT JOIN)
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                    pa_active.territory AS territory
                FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
                    ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
                    ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
                    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
            ) ter ON p.participant_id = ter.master_participant_id
            
            INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
                ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
                AND pta.title_name = m.title
                
            LEFT JOIN NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
                ON ter.territory = tm.territory 
                
            WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
              AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
        ) RawSums
    ) AvgData
) FinalData;

    -- Embedded Title Mapping
    INNER JOIN (

        FROM xactly.xc_period per 
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa

        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos

            AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)

        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta

        WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
    ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
    
    -- Embedded Territory Mapping

SELECT 
    Coalesce(prospera_val, 0) AS prospera_val,
    Coalesce(renasight_val, 0) AS renasight_val,
    Coalesce(others_val, 0) AS others_val,
    (Coalesce(prospera_val, 0) + Coalesce(renasight_val, 0) + Coalesce(others_val, 0)) AS total_val,
    
    -- Safe percentage calculation for Prospera
    CASE 
        WHEN (Coalesce(prospera_val, 0) + Coalesce(renasight_val, 0) + Coalesce(others_val, 0)) = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE CAST((prospera_val * 100.0 / (prospera_val + renasight_val + others_val)) AS DECIMAL(10,1)) 
    END AS prospera_pct,
    
    -- Safe percentage calculation for Renasight
    CASE 
        WHEN (Coalesce(prospera_val, 0) + Coalesce(renasight_val, 0) + Coalesce(others_val, 0)) = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE CAST((renasight_val * 100.0 / (prospera_val + renasight_val + others_val)) AS DECIMAL(10,1)) 
    END AS renasight_pct,

    -- Safe percentage calculation for Others
    CASE 
        WHEN (Coalesce(prospera_val, 0) + Coalesce(renasight_val, 0) + Coalesce(others_val, 0)) = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE CAST((others_val * 100.0 / (prospera_val + renasight_val + others_val)) AS DECIMAL(10,1))

        /* -- MAGIC PRE-FILTER Instantly drop non-OH payments before doing heavy math

name: ntr_oh_attainment
xsql:
SELECT 
    Bucket,
    SUM(CASE WHEN product_name = 'Prospera' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Prospera_Reps,
    SUM(CASE WHEN product_name = 'Renasight' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Renasight_Reps,
    Sort_Order
FROM (
    SELECT 
        product_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN individual_attainment < 80 THEN '< 80%'
            WHEN individual_attainment >= 80 AND individual_attainment < 100 THEN '80-99%'
            WHEN individual_attainment >= 100 AND individual_attainment < 120 THEN '100-119%'
            ELSE '120%+' 
        END AS Bucket,
        CASE 
            WHEN individual_attainment < 80 THEN 1
            WHEN individual_attainment >= 80 AND individual_attainment < 100 THEN 2
            WHEN individual_attainment >= 100 AND individual_attainment < 120 THEN 3
            ELSE 4 
        END AS Sort_Order
    FROM (
        -- PROSPERA ATTAINMENT CALCULATION
        SELECT 
            'Prospera' AS product_name,
            q.position_id,
            CASE 
                WHEN Coalesce(q.quota_amount, 0.00) = 0 THEN 0.00
                ELSE ((Coalesce(c.credit_amount, 0.00) / q.quota_amount) * 100)
            END AS individual_attainment
        FROM (
            SELECT qa.assignment_id AS position_id, SUM(qa.amount) AS quota_amount
            FROM xactly.xc_quota_assignment qa
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_quota q_tbl ON qa.quota_id = q_tbl.quota_id
            INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg ON qa.assignment_id = pos_reg.master_position_id
            WHERE qa.assignment_type = 2
              AND q_tbl.name = 'Prospera Goal'
              AND qa.period_id = :v_period_id
              AND qa.assignment_id IN :v_child_master_position_id
              AND (:p_region = 'ALL' OR pos_reg.region IN (:p_region))
            GROUP BY qa.assignment_id
        ) q
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT cs.position_id, SUM(cs.Total_amount) AS credit_amount
            FROM xactly.xc_credit_summary cs
            INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg ON cs.position_id = pos_reg.master_position_id
            WHERE cs.credit_type_name = 'Prospera'
              AND cs.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
              AND cs.position_id IN :v_child_master_position_id
              AND (:p_region = 'ALL' OR pos_reg.region IN (:p_region))
            GROUP BY cs.position_id
        ) c ON q.position_id = c.position_id

        UNION ALL

        -- RENASIGHT ATTAINMENT CALCULATION
        SELECT 
            'Renasight' AS product_name,
            q.position_id,
            CASE 
                WHEN Coalesce(q.quota_amount, 0.00) = 0 THEN 0.00
                ELSE ((Coalesce(c.credit_amount, 0.00) / q.quota_amount) * 100)
            END AS individual_attainment
        FROM (
            SELECT qa.assignment_id AS position_id, SUM(qa.amount) AS quota_amount
            FROM xactly.xc_quota_assignment qa
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_quota q_tbl ON qa.quota_id = q_tbl.quota_id
            INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg ON qa.assignment_id = pos_reg.master_position_id
            WHERE qa.assignment_type = 2
              AND q_tbl.name = 'Renasight Goal'
              AND qa.period_id = :v_period_id
              AND qa.assignment_id IN :v_child_master_position_id
              AND (:p_region = 'ALL' OR pos_reg.region IN (:p_region))
            GROUP BY qa.assignment_id
        ) q
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT cs.position_id, SUM(cs.Total_amount) AS credit_amount
            FROM xactly.xc_credit_summary cs
            INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg ON cs.position_id = pos_reg.master_position_id
            WHERE cs.credit_type_name = 'Renasight'
              AND cs.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
              AND cs.position_id IN :v_child_master_position_id
              AND (:p_region = 'ALL' OR pos_reg.region IN (:p_region))
            GROUP BY cs.position_id
        ) c ON q.position_id = c.position_id
    ) InlineAttainmentData
) BUCKETED_DATA
GROUP BY Bucket, Sort_Order
ORDER BY Sort_Order;

    -- Metric 2 If Renasight is weaker (Rank number is higher), output the gap, else NULL
    CASE 
        WHEN rank_secondary > rank_primary 
        THEN rank_secondary - rank_primary
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS Renasight_Gap,
    
    -- Hidden Sorter Absolute gap between the two ranks
    CASE 
        WHEN rank_primary > rank_secondary THEN rank_primary - rank_secondary
        WHEN rank_secondary > rank_primary THEN rank_secondary - rank_primary
        ELSE 0 
    END AS Total_Gap

FROM (
    SELECT 
        name, 
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub1_payout DESC) AS rank_primary,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub2_payout DESC) AS rank_secondary
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '(')) AS name, 
            
            -- Capture Prospera Payouts
            SUM(CASE 
                WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Prospera' THEN p.amount 
                ELSE 0 
            END) AS sub1_payout,
            
            -- Capture Renasight Payouts
            SUM(CASE 
                WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Renasight' THEN p.amount 
                ELSE 0 
            END) AS sub2_payout
            
        FROM xactly.xc_payment p
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant part
            ON p.participant_id = part.participant_id
        
        -- 1. Embedded Title Mapping
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                pta.title_name AS title_name
            FROM xactly.xc_period per 
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
            WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
        ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
        
        -- 2. Embedded Territory Mapping (LEFT JOIN)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                pa_active.territory AS territory
            FROM xactly.xc_period per 
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
                ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
                ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
                AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
            WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
        ) ter ON p.participant_id = ter.master_participant_id

        INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
            ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
           AND pta.title_name = m.title
           
        LEFT JOIN NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
            ON ter.territory = tm.territory 
        
        WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
          AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
          AND m.category = 'OH'
        GROUP BY 
            part.name
    ) BaseData
) RankedData
ORDER BY Total_Gap DESC
LIMIT 8;

        ON part.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
        AND CAST(active_per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
        AND CAST(active_per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
    
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
            pta.title_name AS title_name
        FROM xactly.xc_period per 
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
            ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
            ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
            AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
            AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta

    WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id

xsql:
SELECT
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 1 THEN name END), '') AS gap_1_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 1 THEN CAST(rank_primary AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_1_r1,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 1 THEN CAST(rank_secondary AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_1_r2,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 1 THEN CAST(rank_gap AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_1_diff,
    
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 2 THEN name END), '') AS gap_2_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 2 THEN CAST(rank_primary AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_2_r1,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 2 THEN CAST(rank_secondary AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_2_r2,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 2 THEN CAST(rank_gap AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_2_diff,
    
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 3 THEN name END), '') AS gap_3_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 3 THEN CAST(rank_primary AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_3_r1,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 3 THEN CAST(rank_secondary AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_3_r2,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 3 THEN CAST(rank_gap AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_3_diff,
    
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 4 THEN name END), '') AS gap_4_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 4 THEN CAST(rank_primary AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_4_r1,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 4 THEN CAST(rank_secondary AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_4_r2,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 4 THEN CAST(rank_gap AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_4_diff,
    
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 5 THEN name END), '') AS gap_5_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 5 THEN CAST(rank_primary AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_5_r1,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 5 THEN CAST(rank_secondary AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_5_r2,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_gap = 5 THEN CAST(rank_gap AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS gap_5_diff

FROM (
    SELECT 
        name,
        category,
        rank_primary,
        rank_secondary,
        rank_gap,
        Row_Number() OVER (ORDER BY rank_gap DESC) AS rn_gap
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            name, 
            category, 
            RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY sub1_payout DESC) AS rank_primary,
            RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY sub2_payout DESC) AS rank_secondary,
            
            CASE 
                WHEN RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY sub1_payout DESC) > RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY sub2_payout DESC) 
                THEN RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY sub1_payout DESC) - RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY sub2_payout DESC)
                ELSE RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY sub2_payout DESC) - RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY sub1_payout DESC)
            END AS rank_gap
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '(')) AS name, 
                m.category AS category, 
                
                -- Capture the Primary Sub-Category (e.g. Prospera, Initial, Volume)
                SUM(CASE 
                    WHEN m.category = 'OH' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Prospera' THEN p.amount 
                    WHEN m.category = 'ONC' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Initial Patients' THEN p.amount 
                    WHEN m.category = 'WH' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Volume Retention' THEN p.amount 
                    ELSE 0 
                END) AS sub1_payout,
                
                -- Capture the Secondary Sub-Category (e.g. Renasight, Follow-On, Points)
                SUM(CASE 
                    WHEN m.category = 'OH' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Renasight' THEN p.amount 
                    WHEN m.category = 'ONC' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Follow On Patients' THEN p.amount 
                    WHEN m.category = 'WH' AND Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Points Goal' THEN p.amount 
                    ELSE 0 
                END) AS sub2_payout
                
            FROM xactly.xc_payment p
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant part
                ON p.participant_id = part.participant_id
            
            -- 1. Embedded Title Mapping
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                    pta.title_name AS title_name
                FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                    ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                    ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                    ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
                WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
            ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
            
            -- 2. Embedded Territory Mapping (LEFT JOIN)
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                    pa_active.territory AS territory
                FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
                    ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
                    ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
                    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
            ) ter ON p.participant_id = ter.master_participant_id

            INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
                ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
               AND pta.title_name = m.title
               
            LEFT JOIN NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
                ON ter.territory = tm.territory 
            
            WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
              AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
              AND m.category IN ('OH', 'ONC', 'WH')
            GROUP BY 
                part.name, 
                m.category
        ) BaseData
    ) RankedSubcategories
) FinalData;

xsql:
SELECT 
    name AS OHS_Name, 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY payout DESC) AS Final_Rank, 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prospera_payout DESC) AS Prospera_Rank, 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY renasight_payout DESC) AS Renasight_Rank, 
   '$' || Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(payout, 0), '#,###'), '0') AS Total_Payout
FROM (
    SELECT 
        -- Using part.name as requested, with a safe parse just in case there are parentheses 
        CASE 
            WHEN IndexOf(part.name, '(') > 0 THEN SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '(')) 
            ELSE part.name 
        END AS name, 
        
        -- Aggregate Payouts
        SUM(p.amount) AS payout,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Prospera' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS prospera_payout,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Renasight' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS renasight_payout
        
    FROM xactly.xc_payment p
    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant part
        ON p.participant_id = part.participant_id
    
    -- 1. Embedded Title Mapping
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
            pta.title_name AS title_name
        FROM xactly.xc_period per 
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
            ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
            ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
            AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
            AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
            ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
        WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
    ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
    
    -- 2. Embedded Territory Mapping
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
            pa_active.territory AS territory
        FROM xactly.xc_period per 
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
            ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
            ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
            AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
            AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
        WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
    ) ter ON p.participant_id = ter.master_participant_id

    -- 3. Master Mapping
    INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
        ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
       AND pta.title_name = m.title
       
    -- 4. Territory Mapping (Still needed for sub_category fallback, but region logic removed)
    LEFT JOIN NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
        ON ter.territory = tm.territory 
    
    WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
      AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
      AND m.category = 'OH'
      
    GROUP BY 
        part.name
) BaseData
ORDER BY Final_Rank ASC;

                        When m.sub_category IS NULL Then tm.sub_category
                        Else m.sub_category
                    End As sub_category
                From xactly.xc_payment p
                
                /* Inlined Title Mapping */
                Inner Join (
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                        pta.title_name AS title
                    FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                        ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                        ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                        AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                        AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                        ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
                    WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
                ) title On p.participant_id = title.master_participant_id
                
                /* Inlined Territory Mapping & Region Filtering */
                Inner Join (
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                        pa_active.territory AS territory,
                        pa_active.region AS region,
                        pa_active.name AS participant_name
                    FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
                        ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
                        ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
                        AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                        AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                    WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
                ) pa_active On p.participant_id = pa_active.master_participant_id
                
                Inner Join NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
                    On p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
                    And title.title = m.title
                    And m.category = 'ONC'
                Left Join NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
                    On pa_active.territory = tm.territory 
                    
                Where p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                  And p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
                  
                  -- Region Dashboard Filter
                  And ('ALL' IN (:p_region) OR pa_active.region IN (:p_region))
                  
                  And p.earning_group_name IN (
                      Select earning_group 
                      From NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING 
                      Where category = 'ONC'
                  )

            ) raw_data
            Group By ASR_Name
        ) agg_data
    ) windowed_data
) final_data;

SELECT 
    name AS COS_Name,
    
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(rank_primary AS FLOAT) < CAST(rank_secondary AS FLOAT) 
             THEN CAST(rank_secondary AS FLOAT) - CAST(rank_primary AS FLOAT)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS Volume_Retention,
    

    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(rank_secondary AS FLOAT) < CAST(rank_primary AS FLOAT) 
             THEN CAST(rank_primary AS FLOAT) - CAST(rank_secondary AS FLOAT)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS Points_Goal,
    
    -- Sorter column capturing absolute rank variance
    rank_gap AS Total_Gap

FROM (
    SELECT 
        name,
        rank_primary,
        rank_secondary,
        CASE 
            WHEN rank_primary > rank_secondary THEN rank_primary - rank_secondary
            ELSE rank_secondary - rank_primary
        END AS rank_gap
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            name, 
            RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub1_payout DESC) AS rank_primary,
            RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub2_payout DESC) AS rank_secondary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '(')) AS name, 
                
                -- Capture Initial Patients Payout
                SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Volume Retention' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sub1_payout,
                
                -- Capture Follow On Patients Payout
                SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Points Goal' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sub2_payout
                
            FROM xactly.xc_payment p
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant part
                ON p.participant_id = part.participant_id
            
            -- 1. Embedded Position Region Mapping (For Parameter Filter)
            INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg 
                ON p.position_id = pos_reg.master_position_id

            -- 2. Embedded Title Mapping
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                    pta.title_name AS title_name
                FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                    ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                    ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                    ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
                WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
            ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
            
            -- 3. Embedded Territory Mapping
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                    pa_active.territory AS territory
                FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
                    ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
                    ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
                    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
            ) ter ON p.participant_id = ter.master_participant_id

            INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
                ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
               AND pta.title_name = m.title
               
            LEFT JOIN NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
                ON ter.territory = tm.territory 
            
            WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
              AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
              AND m.category = 'WH'
              AND (:p_region = 'ALL' OR pos_reg.region IN (:p_region))
            GROUP BY 
                SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '('))
        ) BaseData
    ) RankedSubcategories
) FinalData
ORDER BY Total_Gap DESC
LIMIT 10;

            name, 
            RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub1_payout DESC) AS rank_primary,
            RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub2_payout DESC) AS rank_secondary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '(')) AS name, 
                
                -- Capture Initial Patients Payout
                SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Initial Patients' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sub1_payout,
                
                -- Capture Follow On Patients Payout
                SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Follow On Patients' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sub2_payout
                
            FROM xactly.xc_payment p
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant part
                ON p.participant_id = part.participant_id
            
            -- 1. Embedded Position Region Mapping (For Parameter Filter)
            INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg 
                ON p.position_id = pos_reg.master_position_id

            -- 2. Embedded Title Mapping
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                    pta.title_name AS title_name
                FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                    ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                    ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                    ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
                WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
            ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
            
            -- 3. Embedded Territory Mapping
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                    pa_active.territory AS territory
                FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
                    ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
                    ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
                    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
            ) ter ON p.participant_id = ter.master_participant_id

            INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
                ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
               AND pta.title_name = m.title
               
            LEFT JOIN NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
                ON ter.territory = tm.territory 
            
            WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
              AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
              AND m.category = 'ONC'
              AND (:p_region = 'ALL' OR pos_reg.region IN (:p_region)) -- Region filter applied here
            GROUP BY 
                SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '('))
        ) BaseData
    ) RankedSubcategories
) FinalData
ORDER BY Total_Gap DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    name AS COS_Name, 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY payout DESC) AS Final_Rank, 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY initial_payout DESC) AS Initial_Patients_Rank, 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY followon_payout DESC) AS Follow_On_Rank, 
    '$' || Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(payout, 0), '#,###'), '0') AS Total_Payout
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN IndexOf(part.name, '(') > 0 THEN SubString(part.name, 0, IndexOf(part.name, '(')) 
            ELSE part.name 
        END AS name, 
        SUM(p.amount) AS payout,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.sub_category = 'Initial Patients' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS initial_payout,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.sub_category = 'Follow On Patients' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS followon_payout
        
    FROM xactly.xc_payment p
    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant part
        ON p.participant_id = part.participant_id
        
    -- FIXED: Tie the period exactly to the payment line to prevent tripling!
    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_period active_per
        ON p.period_id = active_per.period_id
    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
        ON part.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
        AND CAST(active_per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
        AND CAST(active_per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
    
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
            pta.title_name AS title_name
        FROM xactly.xc_period per 
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
            ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
            ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
            AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
            AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
            ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
        WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
    ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
    
    INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
        ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
       AND pta.title_name = m.title
    
    WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
      AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
      AND m.category = 'ONC'
      
      -- The region filter logic applied to the active participant record
      AND ('ALL' IN (:p_region) OR pa_active.region IN (:p_region))
      
    GROUP BY 
        part.name
) BaseData
ORDER BY Final_Rank ASC;
